blocks.text: A South Korean drug lord, who was convicted of murdering three Koreans in the Philippines and accused of running a huge drug distribution network from behind bars, had tried escaping prison by flying over its walls using a heavy-duty drone, according to a report aired Monday. Park Wang-yeol, 47, a drug lord, plotted the his escape shortly before he was temporarily transferred to South Korea in March, local broadcaster JTBC reported.
